title: Native capability declaration v2 (descriptor-owned host metadata)
description: Constrains the host-facing fields of engineering/application/capabilities-v2/*.json that the drift checker derives code from. Every other descriptor field stays feature-owned and is advertised verbatim by discovery (additionalProperties is open on purpose). Source of truth for the Tauri raw object client allowlist (src-tauri/src/native_object_client.rs OPERATIONS) and the per-operation revision advance.

hostOperations.description: Operations reachable only through the private Tauri raw object client. They are deliberately NOT in `operations`, so they never enter the public v2 transport union or MCP discovery registration.

documentKinds.description: Document kinds this capability's operations apply to: `object` (the project kind the application opens today) and/or `opacity` (the single-property native document). Discovery reports an operation available only for a listed kind, and the host refuses an operation declared for another kind. A desktop test sends every operation available for `object` to the real owner and requires that none is refused as unsupported.

purposes.description: One line (at most 110 characters) per operation and host operation of this descriptor, shown by compact discovery's operation list.

useInstead.description: Per document kind, the operation to use instead of an operation that does not apply to it (native or apiVersion 1 operation name to the replacement). Refusals and discovery name the replacement.

rawClient.description: Operations admitted by the Tauri raw object client. A key is the operation name, present means the raw-client flag is set; it must name an operation of `operations` or `hostOperations` of this same descriptor. The set of keys across all descriptors must equal the OPERATIONS allowlist in native_object_client.rs.

revisionDelta.description: How far one successful execution advances the document content revision. Reads declare 0; every command (undo and redo included) is one revision transaction and declares 1.
